title: Police Reportedly Arrest Actor Eric Mabius On Battery Charges | The Daily Caller
text:
Police reportedly arrested “Ugly Betty” star Eric Mabius for battery and resisting an officer without violence Thursday.
The veteran actor was taken into custody on the two misdemeanor charges and was booked into the Nassau County Jail and Detention Center in Florida just before 6:00 a.m., according to TMZ. The outlet reported that his mugshot showed a cut near his right eye and purple bruising on his face. The circumstances leading up to his arrest are not clear as of Thursday afternoon.
BEVERLY HILLS, CA – JULY 26: Eric Mabius attends the 2018 Hallmark Channel Summer TCA at a private residence on July 26, 2018 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo by Rodin Eckenroth/Getty Images)
Mabius starred in a number of shows in the late 1990s, before he achieved mainstream fame for his role in “Ugly Betty.”

The actor also starred in the 2019 Hallmark movie, “It’s Beginning To Look A Lot Like Christmas.” His most recent screen credit was in 2023’s “Haul Out the Holly: Lit Up.” (RELATED: Shocking Video Shows Two Men Beating On OnlyFans Models In Reportedly Sanctioned MMA Fight)
